strategy: Frame analysis, blob tracking, orbital physics modeling with tween-based Revideo animation
agent_behavior: Spent first 20 minutes methodically extracting and analyzing reference video frames using Python/PIL/scipy to identify objects, colors, and motion patterns.
Correctly identified three elements: large stationary central circle, smaller orbiting satellite, and a trail particle on a wider orbit.
Struggled with Revideo's reactive signal system — useTime() didn't work in signal lambdas, pivoted to tween-based animation which worked correctly.
Fitted orbital parameters from frame data: angular velocity ~3 deg/frame CCW for phase 1, then reversal with acceleration in phase 2, with piecewise radius model.
Discovered and modeled the trail particle's separate orbit at ~5.35 deg/frame and larger radius (~139-165px), with fade-out in later phases.
Iterated on angular velocity (refined from 3.0 to 2.985 deg/frame) and radius piecewise model to improve position accuracy in early frames.

Final solution captures the overall visual structure but misses finer details: the reference has dotted orbit rings, multiple satellite colors/sizes (6 satellites per the task description), and 3-phase orbital transitions.
